ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio approximately 85:15 white-to-black pixels, with a dominant high-intensity white field across both lobes and low-intensity black borders and focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white central area across both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated at the trailing edge margin, the central notch base, and in a pattern of hundreds of discrete circular spots (2-12 pixel diameter) distributed across the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 62 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to the lobe peaks of approximately 22% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with amplitudes ranging from 3 to 18 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetrical convex sweep from the peduncle base transitioning to a horizontal-to-slightly-upturned distal tip trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Global distribution of discrete circular and annular (ring-shaped) black pixel clusters across both lobes, varying in density with a higher concentration on the medial sections.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, isolated gray-scale linear streaks detected on the medial-right lobe, approximately 30-50 pixels in length, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense field of circular scars across ventral surface. Prominent clusters of white, high-texture calcified organisms (barnacles) are clearly visible at the distal tips (extremities) of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive uniform distribution of 'pitted' circular scarring and prominent terminal-edge barnacle colonies at the fluke tips.
